highlights.text: Independently deployed multi-agent services on AWS ECS Fargate, with gateways for routing, authentication, and conversation state.

Built Python and Celery pipelines using AWS Bedrock for bill and invoice classification, extraction, and human review, with queue-based workers outside the interactive API request path. Delivered retrieval and report comparisons across **1,000+ listed companies.**
Cut API response time by **50%** through MongoDB aggregation and indexing. Moved I/O-bound Celery workers from prefork to gevent and used Redis Pub/Sub for real-time messaging.

Delivered tenant-aware access controls, Azure AD SSO, SSE streaming, and application email through AWS SES. Built a four-module assessment platform collecting data from **800+ partner organizations.**
